name: GitHub
description: GitHub's hosted MCP server, authenticated with a personal access token. The token decides which repositories are reachable, so it is the whole permission boundary; store it in the credential vault rather than in a config file. GitHub also sells a Copilot-hosted variant of the same endpoint.

probe.note: Answers 401 asking for a Bearer token. It also advertises github.com/login/oauth as an authorization server with repo, read:org, read:user, gist and notification scopes; this catalog records the token path because that server does not publish dynamic client registration.
